classification: Additive opt-in RWA assessment and exact-call evidence binding; no production activation
receiptImpact: Adds a separate Insight RWA v1 EIP-712 domain, strict instrument identity, action-scoped freshness and market-state policy, unsigned diagnostic HTTP/MCP entry points and SDK verifier. Existing safety, coverage, receipt layouts, policies, source groups and historical bytes are unchanged.
activationRule: No partner activation changes. RWA is explicit opt-in with consumer-pinned policy and keys. Caller-supplied diagnostics cannot authorize execution. Fixtures are simulation-only; production requires independently authenticated licensed feeds, instrument halt/corporate-action and issuer evidence plus reviewed signer operations.

compatibilityMatrix.evidence: Existing policy, activation, signed layout and fixture unchanged. RWA schemas and SDK helpers are additive and not automatically invoked. No new partner sign-off or production data coverage is claimed.
